scope: Four derived completed archives from terminal early runs 02 and 03b. The recipes read only the independently recorded original queue path at its exact historical source commit. No active or historical queue, request, human prose, solver, original generator or scientific parameter is edited. All four entire historical source files and the current archive files were read only after their whole sizes were checked below 100000 bytes. The first two are literally the same Git blob at two paths. For the last two, remove only ASCII JSON whitespace outside every string and append LF. The entire resulting target equals the documented former archive byte for byte.
historical_readers: Current or historical descriptions naming archive paths refer to their documented whole bytes. Restore them in scratch with this script, or use the original archive path at old_main_snapshot. The --initial-archive-spelling option restores all four original publication spellings, including the earlier larger raw queue spellings named by the old 03b chain; the default restores the latest pre-retirement whole spellings. No change to live pending lists, closed-job records, failures, attempted IDs or stage history.
